description: a YAML stream holds several resources
source:
apiVersion: sirb/v1alpha1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: support
  labels:
    feature: yes
    "on": "off"
spec:
  modelBinding: claude-default
  instructions: |
    You answer billing questions politely.
---
apiVersion: sirb/v1alpha1
kind: ModelBinding
metadata: {name: claude-default}
spec:
  provider: anthropic
  model: claude-sonnet-5-5
  mode: billable
  budget: {currency: USD, limit: "100", period: month, onExceeded: fallback}
  fallbacks:
    - ref: local-ollama
      triggers: [budget-exceeded]
